chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Uluwiyya al-Isbahani narrated to us, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, he said: Abu Nuaym al-Fadl ibn Dukayn narrated to us, he said: Zakariyya ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, he said: Firas narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, from Aisha, who said:

Fatima (peace be upon her) approached walking as if her walk were the walk of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). The Prophet said: Welcome, my daughter! Then he seated her on his right or on his left. Then he whispered to her and she wept. Then he whispered to her again and she laughed. I said to her: The Messenger of Allah told you something and you wept, then told you something and you laughed. I have never seen joy closer to grief than your joy! I asked her about what he said, and she said: I would not reveal the secret of the Messenger of Allah. When he passed away, I asked her and she said: He confided in me and said: Indeed Gabriel used to review the Quran with me once every year, and this year he reviewed it with me twice. I do not think except that my appointed time has come. And you will be the first of my family to join me, and what an excellent predecessor I am for you. So I wept because of that. Then he said: Would you not be pleased to be the leader of the women of this nation, or the women of the believers? So I laughed because of that.

key_terms.أسرّ: Whispered/confided - secret conversation between Prophet and Fatima
key_terms.سلف: Predecessor - the Prophet as the best predecessor for Fatima in the afterlife
key_terms.سيدة النساء: Leader of women - title given to Fatima by the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet whisper to Fatima that made her cry and then laugh?
ai.summary: Aisha narrates that Fatima came to the Prophet walking with a gait like his. He welcomed her, seated her beside him, and whispered something that made her cry, then whispered again making her laugh. Aisha asked Fatima about it, but she refused to reveal the Prophet's secret. After his passing, Fatima explained: he told her Gabriel had reviewed the Quran with him twice that year (signaling his approaching death) and that she would be the first of his family to join him -- so she wept. Then he told her she would be the leader of the women of this nation or of the believing women -- so she laughed.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Alawiyya al-Isfahani narrated to us from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Abu Nu`aym al-Fadl b. Dakin narrated to us. He said: Zakariyya b. Abi Za’ida narrated to us. He said: Firas narrated to us from al-Sha`bi from Masruq from `A’isha. She said:

Fatima (sa) was walking, and her walk was like the walk of the Messenger of Allah (s). So, the Prophet (s) said: Greetings, daughter. Then, he sat her down to his right or his left. Then, he whispered a saying to her, and she wept. Then, he whispered a saying to her, and she laughed. So, I said to her: The Messenger of Allah said something to you, and you wept, then he said something to you, and you laughed. I have not seen a grief that was so close to laughter until today. She asked her about what he said. So, she said: I would not disclose the secret of the Messenger of Allah (s). When he passed away, I asked her, and she said: He whispered to me and said: “Surely, Gabriel would review the Quran with me one time annually. This year, he reviewed it with me twice. I do not see this except [as a foretelling of] my death. Surely, you will be the first of my Ahl al-Bayt to follow me – and what a blessed predecessor do you have in me. So, she wept at that. Then, he said: Are you not pleased with being the Mistress of the Women of this Nation – rather, the Women of the Believers [altogether]? So, she laughed at that.
